text: ちかくに　たたかえる　トレーナーは　みあたらない…　つかうのを　あきらめた

structure.jp: ちかくに　たたかえる　トレーナーは　みあたらない…
structure.en: no Trainers who can battle are to be found nearby...

structure.jp: つかうのを　あきらめた

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb to the え-row plus る means 'can do'. たたかう becomes たたかえる = 'can battle'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たたかえる　トレーナー
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a person or thing tells you which one it is. たたかえる　トレーナー = 'Trainers who can battle'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing, so another verb can act on it. つかうのを　あきらめた = 'gave up using it'.
